description: Quad Cortex parameters whose 0..1 wire value is not linear in the screen value. Such a parameter plays min + (max - min) * wire ^ exponent, where min and max are the catalogue's range. pyquadcortex converts every parameter linearly, so the matching script and the dump script apply these curves themselves. Measured on a unit (CorOS d14e) by playing known wire values and timing the result; a parameter not listed is taken as linear. Models are named without the (M), (ST) or (S/C) marker.
